The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] utilized a class of '''assault shuttle''' during the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. There existed a [[Imperial shuttle|larger variation]] of these [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], but the Imperial assault shuttles were used far more frequently than their larger counterparts in the Sith Empire's many wars with the republic.

==Description==
The assault shuttle utilized two wings in a bent-wing configuration when moving. These wings could be folded up when the shuttle landed, allowing the shuttle to take up less space on hangar floors. A landing ramp was used to board and reboard the vessel, leading up to the main entry hatch.

==History==
One [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was used by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] assault party from the ''[[Black Talon]]'' to board the ''[[Brentaal Star]]'' in order to retrieve or eliminate a [[The General|key republic officer]] during an an [[Attack on the Brentaal Star|unexpected mission]]. This was not an official military conflict, however, as the ''Black Talon'' was simply a cargo and passenger vessel on it's way to the Sith [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The entire attack was orchestrated by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] without the prior knowledge of any of the ''Black Talon''{{'s}} crew.

In addition, an Imperial assault shuttle was used by an Imperial strike team in [[3643 BBY]] to [[Battle aboard the Voidstar|board]] the long-missing [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] the ''[[Voidstar]]'' and retrieve a set of schematics for a prototype [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. An assault shuttle was also displayed in the [[Corellian Museum of Starships]] during the Cold War, and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] used the shuttle to infiltrate the [[Korvalus Tower]], [[Tyrelli Habitat]], and the [[Gowix Corp superstructure]] to destroy the [[Firestorm Turbolaser]]s there as part of a [[Battle of Corellia|much larger mission]] to stop the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] from completing [[Emperor's ritual crisis|his plans]].
